# Chunk C6: Auth, logging, README, production

You are building chunk C6 of cpanel-mail-mcp, a Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server that gives Claude IMAP access to Scott's three cPanel business mailboxes. Read `docs/spec.md` (tag `spec-v1.4`), `docs/build/traceability.md`, `docs/prerequisites.md` and `docs/build/spec-questions.md` before writing code.

## Goal

Replace the staging token with OAuth, add logging and the README, and deploy production.

## Rules for this chunk (read first)

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.4`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.
3. If a requirement is unclear, contradicts another, or needs a decision the spec does not make: do not decide it. Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Add `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C6 --strict` to the unit job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, next to the earlier chunks' lines.
5a. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C6`. Open a pull request titled `C6: Auth, logging, README, production`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

Spec question format (append to `docs/build/spec-questions.md`):

```
## Q<n> (C6)
REQ: <id(s)>
Question: <what is unclear>
Options: <2 or 3 readings>
Blocking: <yes/no; what is skipped until answered>
Resolution:
```

## Deliverables

- workers-oauth-provider with GitHub upstream, single allowed login ironfis1, token lifetimes per REQ-3-5 and REQ-3-6, revocation by grant deletion, no authless path (section 3). Remove `STAGING_TOKEN` support entirely.
- Structured logging with exactly the REQ-18-2 fields and the section 13 exclusions.
- README: secrets and binding names (REQ-18-12), password rotation (REQ-2-16, REQ-13-6), signature-change procedure (REQ-10-5), cPHulk unblock (REQ-13-7), revocation.
- Production deploy job that runs only from a git tag.

## Required tests

- Log exclusion tests (REQ-14-17).
- OAuth tests: non-allowed login refused, token lifetimes, refresh rotation.

- From the C1 review: `ImapError` carries `serverText` (the raw server response). REQ-13-3 forbids raw server error text in logs, so the logger must never write `serverText` or an error's full message; log the error class code only. Include a test that throws an `ImapError` with `serverText` and asserts nothing of it reaches the log.

- From the C2 review: REQ-2-19 is partial until OAuth exists. Add the OAuth test to its "Verified by" cell and set it to `built`.

## Success criteria (all must hold before the PR is ready)

- All automated rows passing.
- Production deployed from a tag.
- From claude.ai, `availability` reports all three live accounts reachable. No writes to live mailboxes in this chunk.
- `node scripts/trace.mjs --chunk C6 --strict` passes.
- No new spec questions left unlisted in the PR.

## Gate (not part of the Claude Code prompt)

1. Claude Code opens the PR and stops.
2. Scott tells Claude in claude.ai: "verify C6, PR #<n>". Claude independently reads the diff, re-runs the unit tests, reads CI results, checks every in-scope REQ against its test, and checks for behavior the spec does not state. Verdict: PASS, or FAIL with findings.
3. Scott reviews the verdict and the PR, does any "Scott" actions below, and merges or sends findings back to Claude Code.

Scott actions for this chunk:

- Create a GitHub OAuth app with the callback URL Claude Code gives you; put its ID and secret into the Worker with `wrangler secret put --env production`.
- Set the three live mailbox passwords on production (`IMAP_PASS_REASINGER_SCOTT`, `IMAP_PASS_YCD_SCOTT`, `IMAP_PASS_YCD_FOUNDERS`).
- Add the production URL as a custom connector in claude.ai and sign in with GitHub.
